notes.title: Update 2 Out NOW
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're back with a new update! Its almost the 1 year anniversary of Soundelta's release! It would have been cool to release this update on the day of(April 12th), but we wanted to get this one out as soon as possible so we're a few days early. Thank you for following our journey this past year.

This update is focused on polish and quality of life, as well as many behind the scenes technical improvements. We're now nearly done with our technical goals and can go full speed ahead on content from now on! Please look forward to it.

These are going to be some long patch notes, so buckle up!

[h1]New Song[/h1]
Being a technical update doesn't mean it doesn't include any new content! 

[h2]AXiS - POLTERGEIST[/h2]
[h3]SD 6 / HD 9 / ED 12[/h3]
Available in Singles Pack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/ef53207ae0f0719ad13a09e58bc143b3fdccddb9.png[/img]
Introducing POLTERGEIST by AXiS, a punishingly difficult song featuring wilder mapping and VFX than any previous official map! Good luck and have fun


[h1]Clarity[/h1]
One of the main goals of this update was improving gameplay clarity, and we've made several changes to help with that.

[h3]Note Colors[/h3]
You can now set individual colors for each lane of notes, helping you see what's coming up next.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/b6e36d84d6d49cf18deec00bd071ae6f037e1573.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/1fbf13a977021fdcdc3677002235538e28f89419.png[/img]

[h3]Updated Spin Model[/h3]
The Spin model has been updated to better indicate its direction with its shape.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/2d9adaac213d37f2232c651eda94aead52b6f892.png[/img]

[h3]Graphics Tweaks[/h3]
Notes and hit effects are no longer affected by bloom, which could turn them into distracting glowy messes when VFX gets more intense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/f9953de645e3e21fbcc7ff26f5fb3e80da743ef2.png[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life and Polish[/h1]
Next up, improvements to the player experience and presentation of the game!

[h3]Unlock and SP Cost Changes[/h3]
Let's be real. The unlock system was too restrictive, especially for more experienced rhythm game players. That's why as of this update, all songs in Singles Pack now have their SD and HD difficulties unlocked by default, and SP costs have been significantly reduced across the board to streamline the unlock process.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/256087a09bbc2d49039d77b96f9078acf03ca646.png[/img]

[h4]Other Little Things[/h4]
Song select has had some animation improvements and strange behavior fixed. Sorting has been improved, falling back to alphabetical when sorting cannot be performed, and Number Fonts have been made more consistent across sections of UI. 
The Graphics and Performance settings have also been cleaned up and reorganized. Notably, Force Native Resolution is now a part of the Resolution setting as the "Auto" option and Vsync is now a part of the Limit FPS setting. We've also reorganized and renamed the two categories. 


[h1]Technical improvements[/h1]
Next, technical improvements! Making the game better at its core, one step at a time. 

[h3]Audio Improvements[/h3]
We've begun implementing a new audio system that allows the game to play sounds with low latency. Thanks to it, we can now play hitsounds on your actual inputs! This setting is marked as experimental for now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/a33b8e433f1017914da7b71e739d092c4152e9c3.png[/img]

We've also replaced the old Low Latency Mode with the Audio Buffer setting, because it didn't fit the large variety of audio devices out there. This new setting allows you to dial in latency reduction to what's just right for your device.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/0126230cd8d2cd37942ab42b79acec5860204aca.png[/img]

[h3]Antialiasing[/h3]
Have you ever thought the lane lines looked strange? MSAA is here to fix that! The Antialiasing setting has been revamped to include new options!(Previously the game only used SMAA)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/f8785a9764b81e8fafb45b735d26da9d8a851d5a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/182a78556ffd9a13ce1af2d59bb7977e32d76022.png[/img]

And last but not least,
[h3]Vector Graphics[/h3]
A large amount of the game's UI has been changed to vector graphics, allowing it to cleanly scale to any resolution!


[h1]Editor[/h1]
We love adding new features to the editor!

[h3]New Effect[/h3]
This update adds Film Grain to the effects list, for your grainy, noisy needs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/55327a582d743fdc339387ae10dfea9b7f20ef22.png[/img]

[h3]Don't Interpolate[/h3]
To streamline the effect workflow, effect points now have a new parameter, Don't Interpolate! When enabled, this makes the value snap directly to the point's value instead of interpolating from the previous, making this common behavior much simpler to make.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/dd60d9cadec7dc5befce20cd46c23cf3f25491e7.png[/img]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
More bugs have been squashed with this update, largely relating to the UI and navigation. Once again, we are sorry about how long its taken for this update to come out. If you find a bug, please do to tell us about it. See the full patch notes below for more information.

And before we forget,
[h1]Unity 6[/h1]
The game is now updated to Unity 6!
What does this mean for you, the player? The game no longer has the Unity splash screen, speeding up startup times! That's mainly it for things you'll notice immediately, but it also helps with a lot of behind the scenes things we're doing and makes development a little easier.


[h3]That's it for this update! See you next time.[/h3]
[h3]Thank you for playing Soundelta![/h3]


[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
Soundelta EarlyAccess Update 2(Build 1163)

Additions
- Added new song: AXiS - Poltergeist
- Added settings: Realtime Hitsounds(experimental), Lane color
- Added film grain to effects system
- Added Don’t Interpolate to effect channel points which will instantly snap to the value at the time instead of interpolating from the previous point
- Replaced Low Latency Mode setting with Audio Buffer setting. This is able to fit different audio devices better than a single toggle could. The setting value should be automatically determined by whether you previously had Low Latency Mode on or not, however please check it.
- Added new Antialiasing options, including MSAA

Changes
- Updated game to Unity 6
- Converted most UI elements to vector graphics
- Optimized Song Select and Results UI performance
- Changed spin note models to better indicate direction
- Notes and hit effects are no longer affected by bloom
- Decreased SP costs of unlocks
- SD and HD difficulties of Singles pack songs are now available without unlocking
- Spin notes now additionally display judgement on the centered position in both input position modes for more clarity
- Changed colors of various ui elements in editor for better contrast
- Merged Force Native Resolution setting into the Resolution setting as a dropdown option called Auto
- Merged Vsync into Limit FPS setting as a dropdown option
- Removed some unused settings internally
- Moved some settings between Graphics and Performance categories and renamed Graphics category to Display and Performance to Graphics
- Song select sorting now automatically falls back to alphabetical for cases where it cannot sort (such as if you do not have a score on that song while sorting by score)
- Switched order of rate clear and rank icons 


Fixes
- Fixed long song artist names going out of the box in gameplay UI
- Fixed an issue with calibration where after clicking restart, the first input would be ignored
- Fixed a bug where you could hit hold notes earlier than their actual timing window
- Fixed a bug where the game could sometimes not load the cover art of a ED difficulty
- Screen resolution detection is no longer affected by inconsistent decimals in refresh rate numbers which certain displays have
- Fixed a bug in editor where it would sometimes not load the song
- Certain key presses no longer pass through into song select while settings or profile menu is open
- Effect channel output on a newly created channel no longer disappears if you do not set a value the first time you select it
- Loading screen when selecting a pack now properly waits until all of the songs in the pack are completely loaded
- Fixed the sort method dropdown in song select being too large
- Fixed a bug where sometimes the up and down arrow keys could do nothing in song select
- Song select no longer plays the cover art changing animation if the cover art is the same when changing difficulties(And some misc animation fixes)
- Fixed some number font inconsistencies

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with Steam Cloud save implementation where it tries to access files that may not previously exist before they are created, preventing save files from loading

notes.title: Update 1 Out NOW
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Its been a while, but we're back with Soundelta's first major update! Let's get straight into what's new.


[h1]New Songs[/h1]
This update brings 2 new songs to Soundelta!

[h2]JinoBeats - DEATH OF THE CRIMSON STAR[/h2]
[h3]SD 5 / HD 8 / ED 11[/h3]
Available in Singles Pack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/6759042881d426468ac5331824291628c542b07d.png[/img]


[h2]Lundy ft. Edyn - I'll Be Your Universe(Lundy's Star Garage Remix)[/h2]
[h3]SD 4 / HD 7 / ED 10[/h3]
Available in Singles Pack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/db88434f5df1679e5324f64d68c259ecc779679b.png[/img]

We hope you'll enjoy these new songs from these amazing artists!


[h1]Updated UI[/h1]
UI gets some well deserved love this update, with improvements to Song Select and a redesigned Results screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/19b125c05f2769a404fc2df3361e96982a06a7a4.png[/img]
Song Select now has a background, indicators for which song and difficulty are selected, as well as some miscellaneous changes(See full patch notes below for more information)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44848920/3a96dec8cca4977f5de309cb1eed5b731dc92a0b.png[/img]
Results screen gets the same background treatment, as well as a new layout!


[h1]Editor Improvements[/h1]
The editor's Effect system was pretty confusing. You could tell it was built as a devtool first and users second. This update takes the first steps on making it more user friendly with changes to value scaling. New maps will use an absolute value system, instead of the previous relative 0-100%, with clearly defined min, max, and default values for each output type, as well as having only one output per channel. The editor manual has also been updated for your reference. Preexisting maps will continue to use the old system. The game and editor will automatically recognize them.



[h1]Bugfixes and Other Improvements[/h1]
This update includes improvements to various parts of the game, and more bugs have been squished, mostly related to the editor and UI. Some of these have existed for a very long time, sorry if you have been affected by any and for the long delay between patches. 
See full patch notes below for more information.


[h3]That's it for this update! See you next time.[/h3]
[h3]Thank you for playing Soundelta![/h3]


[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
Soundelta EarlyAccess Update 1(Build 1158)

Added new songs: 
- JinoBeats - DEATH OF THE CRIMSON STAR
- Lundy ft. Edyn - I’ll Be Your Universe(Lundy’s Star Garage Remix)

Additions
- Added metronome click before song start to indicate bpm
- Added Camera FOV and Pixelate to effects system

Changes
- Updated UI of song select and results 
- Song buttons now have an animation to indicate which one is selected
- Changing sorting method in song select now automatically scrolls to the new position of the currently selected song’s button
- Adjusted scroll sensitivity of some scroll rects
- Changed spin hitsound
- Reduced how often save file is written to(it was a bit excessive and caused some lagspikes in inconvenient times)
- Optimized textures slightly
- Game now has Steam Cloud Save support built in(Previously used autosave on Steam’s end)
- Renamed “OST Pack 1” to “Originals”
- Renamed “Singles Pack” to “Singles”
- Changed main menu logo to full name version

- Changed effects workflow in editor to be more user friendly(Old maps are still supported, but new maps will default to the new system)
   - Changed effects system from relative(0-100%) to absolute values
   - Effect channels in editor can now only have one output
   - Effect channels now show min, max, and default values depending on the output type
   - Channel point Value now has default values depending on the output type(No more guessing!) 
- Updated editor manual

Fixes
- Fixed editor not being able to automatically determine song length when picking a song file for the first time
- Editor tab 4 shortcut now goes to the correct tab
- Fixed layout of Profile UI to properly fit a full Best Scores section
- Fixed the letter “j” in title text going out of the box in song select
- Fixed overlapping click hitboxes of song pack buttons
- Fixed a minor animation issue with song select when changing map
- Editor no longer sometimes becomes non functional if you start preview near the end of the song

Map adjustments:
- Decreased Redshift(ED) rating to 8

notes.title: Patch: Build 1144
notes.notes:
Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1144

Additions
- Added Left Color and Right Color settings, which allow you to set the color of spin notes

Changes
- Redesigned some UI elements 
- The indicators from Timing Boxes setting now have separate colors corresponding with judgements
- Arrow indicators for spin notes now always show at a fixed amount of time before the spin note

Fixes
- Removed a blank 4th option in VFX quality dropdown
- The editor is now always able to play the first hitsound when preview is started

notes.title: Patch: Build 1138
notes.notes:
Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1138

Additions
- Added keyboard navigation to select screen, pause screen, and results screen
- You can now access Settings and Profile from select screen
- Added Judgement Position setting, which lets you switch between judgement indicators being on lanes or in the center of the screen

Changes
- Rearranged song select UI slightly
- Unlock screen now automatically closes if you select a map that is already unlocked while it is open
- Title and artist name texts now have dynamic scaling for long names
- Increased maximum difficulty option in editor to 15

Fixes
- Fixed certain UI boxes having an incorrect color tint
- Screen transition can no longer trigger again while the transition is already in progress(This caused some weirdness before)
- Resolution setting now defaults to the maximum possible resolution (Might fix the game defaulting to the wrong resolution on some systems)
- Having several empty groups no longer breaks map loading
- The editor no longer gets stuck loading certain projects even if it is valid data

notes.title: Patch: Build 1137
notes.notes:
This patch includes some miscellaneous bugfixes and UI design changes

Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1137

Additions
- Added images to pack buttons in song select
- Added Custom indicator on result screen for custom maps

Changes
- The Map Error popup in song select now automatically closes if you select a different map with no errors while its still open
- Removed Input Offset setting(3 offset types is a bit excessive)
- Made some changes to main menu and song select UI
- Diagonal dropdowns now have diagonal scrollbars

Fixes
- The song no longer doesn’t play if a map’s Preview Time is 0
- Hitsounds on the first note now play
- Result screen now correctly counts misses on holds

notes.title: Patch: Build 1136
notes.notes:
This patch includes fixes for various editor issues, as well as adjustments to gameplay and improvements to accessibility

Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1136

Additions
- Added switch to toggle VFX on song select screen
- Added separate judgment counts for each note type on results screen

Changes
- The song file is now preloaded in the editor(Removes the lagspike when starting preview for the first time after opening a project)
- Increased Perfect timing window to +-42ms(Previously +-36ms) and Almost window to +-64ms(Previously +-60ms)
- Hold notes now tick half as often
- Slightly decreased the size of the spin note model to improve visibility

Fixes
- Start Time no longer has inconsistent behavior between editor and gameplay
- File pickers in editor now open the correct folder
- Notes in editor are now correctly synced with the song when timescale is not 1
- Timestamp on the editor seek bar now accounts for Start Time
- Increased input buffer for keyboard shortcuts in editor. May prevent inputs registering twice if that happened to you

Map adjustments
- Reduced the variance of scroll speed changes in the following maps: Bonus Stage!(HD, ED), Chromax(SD, HD, ED), Delta Drive(SD, HD, ED), Redshift(SD, HD, ED), Reflection(SD, HD, ED), Sea of Stars(SD, HD, ED), Vector Wave(SD, HD, ED), jittter(SD, ED), Overclocked(SD, HD, ED) 
- Increased Redshift(HD) rating to 7
- Removed a note that was not supposed to be there in Vector Wave(HD)

notes.title: Patch: Build 1135
notes.notes:
This patch includes fixes for audio related issues and various other bugs

Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1135

Changes
- Reduced SP costs for HD and ED unlocks

Fixes
- You can no longer press esc to close the settings menu while in Audio Calibration
- Fixed issues with Audio Calibration that caused it to not be accurate for a large number of setups
- Editor end time is no longer forced to be the maximum, and no longer the wrong maximum value
- Hitsounds in editor autoplay are now timed correctly when timescale is not 1
- Volume reduction when game is out of focus is no longer overridden by song select preview fade in and out
- When starting editor preview at a time in the middle of the song, the music and hitsounds now always have correct sync(They would randomly desync before)

notes.title: Patch: Build 1134
notes.notes:
This patch includes fixes for various monitor related issues, as well as other miscellaneous bugs

Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1134

Additions
- Added setting Force Native Resolution for if there are problems with the Resolution setting

Changes
- Adjusted UI to layout properly on taller than 16:9 aspect ratios
- Music volume is now reduced when alt tabbed out
- Tutorial now forces you to follow the instructions to continue and has additional reminder text
- You can no longer set Render Scale above 1.0(This caused issues)

Fixes
- You can no longer drag the health bar on the results screen
- The game now correctly recognizes the available resolutions when you move it from 1 monitor to another
- The game now correctly recognizes certain resolutions that have strange decimal values in the refresh rate

notes.title: Hotfix: Build 1132
notes.notes:
This patch includes bugfixes and QOL/UX improvements

Patch notes
Soundelta EarlyAccess build 1132

Changes
- Timings for catching holds are now more lenient(Equal to Ok window now)
- Removed setting Split Center Lane. Key 2 alt now always works as long as it is bound to something
- The Timing field of the first bpm change in editor is now greyed out(This value should never be changed)
- When selecting a song or cover art in editor, if you select a file that is not already inside the map’s Assets folder, it now automatically copies the file to there

Fixes
- Pressing esc in song select no longer crashes the game
- Added protection against invalid Screen Resolution setting value breaking the settings menu
- Autoplay in editor now correctly removes notes after they are deleted

Thank you to everyone in the Discord server who reported bugs and gave feedback. 
You can join it here:
https://discord.gg/nN4ZRXBeng

Thank you for your support!
